    Kisiei–English dictionary¶

    This dictionary is generated automatically from the project's lexicon (6650 entries). Words follow the Kisiei alphabetical order (ɛ after e, ŋ and ɲ after n, ɔ after o); tone marks are ignored for sorting. The underline of each word shows its source, as elsewhere in this guide: Attested in the Bible (with a reference to one occurrence), Confirmed by a speaker, Respelled from an older written source (named after the entry), To check, or Southern Kissi (Childs 2000 only, not attested in the North). To look up a word from English, see the English–Kisiei index; for words grouped by theme, see the word lists. The full lexicon is also available as CSV, TSV, LIFT and CLDF in the repository.

    amanndiee n. — almond, almond tree (yɔm amanndiee). Num 17:23

    amoniɔmndo n. — harmonium. Terminologie (arts), n° 147

    a1 prep. — with; and. Gen 1

    a2 pron. — you (sg.); they (subject). Gen 1
